svg.desc: A syntax-highlighted JavaScript object describing Samiullah Darwish, a Software Developer in Afghanistan, with Python, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. An anonymous illustrated developer sits in a softly lit coding room beside a city window. The illustration is decorative, not a portrait.
